title: Foraging
summary: FOR'AGING, participle present tense or adjective Collecting provisions for horses and cattle, or wandering in search of food; ravaging; stripping. The general sent out a foraging party, with a guard.

inlines.v: FOR'AGING, participle present tense or adjective Collecting provisions for horses and cattle, or wandering in search of food; ravaging; stripping. The general sent out a foraging party, with a guard. FOR'AGING, noun An inroad or incursion for forage or plunder.
